states.changed: The work exists: every IPC area since January 2021 hung as one cloth of 813 threads, the unclassified areas left as holes the light comes through, with a readout, one thread laid out, and the one hole whose reason the IPC wrote.

The cloth now hangs from a rod: above every thread a bead shows how much of the country's appeal was funded that year and a lamp shows whether FEWS NET filed an analysis that month (every lamp out from January to June 2025), and the visitor can re-hang the cloth by what was given or pick out the threads analysed while the monitor was dark.

The cloth now answers whether the cuts sit over the holes: the six months FEWS NET filed nothing run down through it as a dark band under a monitor strip on the rod, every hole is drawn bright and never faded, the cloth can be hung by time, by country with names, or by what was given, each with one sentence saying what the hang shows (the holes do not gather under the dark or the thin money), it can be seen close enough to tap a thread, Sudan's written reason is marked where it hangs, and a light can cross the months with a hum that stops when the monitor went dark.
